attempts.sql: WITH RECURSIVE api AS (SELECT symbol_id FROM code.symbols WHERE file_id = 'auto_ontology/server/models.py' AND name = 'ApiModel' AND kind = 'class'), direct AS (SELECT cb.class_symbol_id FROM code.class_bases cb JOIN api ON cb.base_symbol_id = api.symbol_id UNION SELECT cb.class_symbol_id FROM code.class_bases cb JOIN api ON cb.base_name = 'ApiModel' UNION SELECT cb.class_symbol_id FROM code.class_bases cb JOIN api ON cb.base_name = '_Payload'), edges AS (SELECT cb.class_symbol_id AS child, cb.base_symbol_id AS parent FROM code.class_bases cb WHERE cb.base_symbol_id IS NOT NULL), reach(child, ancestor, depth) AS (SELECT child, parent, 1 FROM edges UNION ALL SELECT r.child, e.parent, r.depth + 1 FROM reach r JOIN edges e ON r.ancestor = e.child), depths AS (SELECT r.child AS class_symbol_id, MIN(r.depth) AS depth FROM reach r JOIN api ON r.ancestor = api.symbol_id GROUP BY r.child) SELECT d.class_symbol_id, CAST(d.depth AS INTEGER) AS depth FROM depths d WHERE d.class_symbol_id NOT IN (SELECT class_symbol_id FROM direct) ORDER BY d.class_symbol_id

request:
Which classes inherit from ApiModel (auto_ontology/server/models.py) only indirectly, i.e. through at least one intermediate class of this repository, and do not name ApiModel directly in their class statement? An import alias of ApiModel (auto_ontology/server/responses.py imports it as _Payload) counts as naming ApiModel directly, and a subscripted base such as ListResponse[T] counts as its class. For each, give the class symbol ID and the length of the shortest inheritance chain to ApiModel (2 when the parent class directly subclasses ApiModel).

Requested output columns: class_symbol_id (string), depth (integer).
explanation: Builds the inheritance graph from code.class_bases and finds the shortest path from each class to ApiModel in auto_ontology/server/models.py. Classes that name ApiModel (or its alias _Payload) directly in their class statement are excluded, leaving only classes that reach ApiModel through at least one intermediate class. The depth is the number of inheritance edges to ApiModel.
